text:
maria_zhang: Heads-up — sampleapp CI failing on macOS/arm64 w/ ruby-wasm gem. Build error: can't find 'ffi_c' native extension. Anyone hit this?

samir_k: seen similar on CI when compiling libffi in musl docker. Can you paste the make log?

maria_zhang: paste snippet:

```shell
compiling ext/ffi_c/ffi.c
undefined reference to `ffi_prep_cif'
make: *** [ffi_c.so] Error 1
```

samir_k: hmm. For wasm targets we should be using the pure-ruby fallback. Is the gem trying to build native ext because of missing RUBY_ENGINE check?

rob-sdkbot: CI: sampleapp / main — failed (https://ci.internal.redwood/sampleapp/1234) :machine: 

maria_zhang: repro steps I ran locally:

1. docker run --platform=linux/arm64 -v $(pwd):/app ruby:3.2
2. bundle install
3. rake test

samir_k: quick workaround: export RUBY_WASM_NO_NATIVE=1 before bundle install — forces fallback. Not ideal though.

tom_sre: can we change gemspec to detect wasm and skip ext? small PR should be safe. tag: devex

maria_zhang: I'll open a PR with a conditional in extconf to skip on wasm + add CI matrix test for --platform=linux/arm64. @rob-sdkbot can you queue a review when it's up? :pray:

rob-sdkbot: PR queued: https://git.internal.redwood/sampleapp/pulls/789 — added reviewers samir_k, tom_sre

kelly_ds: +1 on adding matrix test. also make a small note in quickstart README for mac M1 devs.

maria_zhang: thanks all — will do the PR today. cc @samir_k for review

samir_k: happy to review. :thumbsup:
